transfer.stem: Which notes keep the walkers, the town’s famous craft and the meeting place correct?
transfer.passage:
A visit to a craft town
Our class met at the usual place by the library before visiting a craft town. I felt nervous about giving a short performance. “It is normal to feel nervous before a performance,” our teacher said. She did not predict how my performance would go.
We took a riverside path that was popular with local walkers. At the workshop, our guide explained that the town was famous for its handmade baskets. A metal bucket stood nearby, but it was not the craft that the guide had named. A diagram gave us an excellent explanation of the weaving process.
After the visit, I put some spare screws into a small box that was perfect for them. Outside the workshop, we saw a leaf with an unusual shape. The gardener reminded us that the young plants needed special care in winter. She did not give us a daily watering amount.

options.text: The path is liked by local walkers; the town is known for handmade baskets; the class met beside the library.
The path is liked by everyone in the world; the town is known for metal buckets; the class met far from the library.
The path is liked by local walkers; the town is known for metal buckets; the class met beside the library.
The path is liked by local walkers; the town is known for handmade baskets; the class met at a completely new place far from the library.
